name: vacuum-furnace-gauge
_comment: The vacuum gauge's needle (spec 6), drawn by Animatorio over the dial the model renders bare. Cut by tools/build-animatorio-layers.py --phase linear --frame0 still: the plate's housing with the dial's window punched out, and 16 frames of that window, the same loop as the flywheel's.

motions._where: The dial lies flat on the pump barrel's head, so through this camera it draws as a circle: centre and radius measured off sheets/base.png (the pivot at 178.5, 177.3, re-measured 2026-10-08 after the radiators raised the plate 10 px; the face 5.2 px across the hood).
motions._reading: A pump holding its vacuum: the needle sits at a working reading, up and to the right, and pulses a few degrees with the strokes -- once a loop, never sweeping the dial.
motions._size: Wide for its 5 px: a needle much under 2 px wide is blended into the dial by the downsample and reads as a grey smudge (first cut, 2026-10-08).
